entries.summary: Hue Northern Bus Station is a road-travel scene on the city's north side, with coach buses, bags, Vietnamese signs, and the rhythm of departures.
entries.context: Bến xe phía Bắc Huế is the local name for the northern bus station and its north-side terminal area.
entries.tip: Pair the station name with your destination so the terminal side and route are clear.
entries.rationale: It belongs because road travel around Hue has specific terminals with their own city-side context.

entries.summary: Toa Kham Boat Station gives travelers a central Perfume River landing name for dragon boat departures, riverside meetups, and route questions.
entries.context: Bến thuyền Tòa Khâm is the name to use when asking for the boat station by the river.
entries.tip: Ask whether your boat leaves from this landing specifically; Hue has more than one river access point.
entries.rationale: It belongs because river plans become much easier when travelers can name the actual landing.
